title: An Anonymized Urn-Based Experimental Dataset on Decision-Making under Risk and Ambiguity
abstract: arXiv:2608.26358v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This data paper describes an anonymized release derived from controlled behavioral experiments on decision-making under risk (known probabilities) and ambiguous uncertainty (partially specified or unknown probabilities) in Ellsberg-type urn tasks. The release contains 4,486 decision records from 246 adult participant records across two implementations (laboratory and online). In each task, participants reported their maximum stake to enter a subsequent lottery; these stake responses can be interpreted as proxies for willingness to pay within the implemented incentive mechanism. In a subset of tasks, participants also selected the color they wished to bet on. The online implementation additionally includes ex-post evaluations of perceived uncertainty across situations. translated_title: 基于风险与模糊决策的匿名瓮式实验数据集
translated_abstract: 本数据论文描述了一个匿名化发布的数据集，该数据集源自对风险（已知概率）和模糊不确定性（部分指定或未知概率）下决策行为的受控行为实验，采用埃尔斯伯格型瓮任务。该数据集包含来自两个实施场景（实验室和在线）的246名成年参与者的4,486条决策记录。在每项任务中，参与者报告其进入后续抽奖的最大投注金额；这些投注响应可解释为在实施的激励机制下支付意愿的代理指标。在部分任务中，参与者还选择了他们希望下注的颜色。在线实施还额外包括对情境中感知不确定性的事后评估。该存储库进一步提供了详细的游戏定义、实现的抽奖结果、参与者说明以及变量数据字典。源导出包含所有必要信息以供复现和分析。
tldr: 该论文发布了一个包含4,486条决策记录的匿名化实验数据集，涵盖风险与模糊条件下的决策行为，并提供了完整的任务定义、结果和变量字典以支持复现。
en_tdlr: This paper releases an anonymized dataset of 4,486 decision records on risk and ambiguity in Ellsberg-type tasks, with full game definitions, outcomes, and variable dictionaries for reproducibility.
